what: Eclipse gathering at Thanesar: as many as 100,900 persons; tank bathed in yearly by double or treble that number; no ascetic order named
quote: At Thanesar as many as 100,900 persons have been known, even of late years, to assemble on the occasion of an eclipse

what: Month of Chait: large concourse including distant pilgrims; relief establishments at Thanesar (Patiala) and Pehowa (Patiala and Nabha)
quote: At Pehowa the sacred monthis that of Chait (Mar.-April), during which a large concourse of people, including pilgrims from a distance, is collected.
